text: Operational activations include a multi-mechanism response to Cyclone Remal in May 2024, which displaced an estimated 800,000 people. The initiative is 57.4% complete as of mid-2025, with substantial progress in developing country-specific risk models and financing architecture. However, specific quantifiable impact metrics tied to Start Ready allocations in Bangladesh are not yet published.

metadata.solution_name: Start Ready (Start Network’s disaster risk financing mechanism)
